narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the project.
finalText:
**Build passes now, exit 0.** Two real bugs, not noise.

`resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but the bump renamed it `retryCount`. It threw `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed')`. Fixed at [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6), old name still works.

`isBackoffEnabled` threw on unset flags. The new loader gives `undefined`, not `false`. Unset now means off. See [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7).

The other 8 warnings are real deprecations in `src/legacy`. No file exists for them here.

Next: port `src/legacy` off `Buffer()` and `crypto.createCipher`.
